question: how many `imports` edges name a PUBLIC IDENTIFIER instead of a file

corpus.method: git-tracked files only, 512 KiB cap, detectLanguageFromPath(abs, text) — the arbiter's own rule

treeSide.note: instrument A, grammar inventory: counted from the parse tree with no reference to the analyzer, so it is the number a correct implementation would have to match

edgeSide.note: instrument B, from production parseFile; externalIdKind is the analyzer's own record of which literal it read

disagreement.reading: A tree node with no SystemLiteral and an emitted edge carrying externalIdKind=public is the fabrication. If the two agree there is no bug and the rule is redundant; if the edge count exceeds the node count the analyzer is inventing edges the tree does not carry.
